how_to_apply: Fill the application in the format attached to the advertisement, with complete biodata.
Enclose self-attested photocopies of mark sheets, certificates and supporting documents, including experience.
Send it by registered or speed post to Dr. Varun Rai, PI, Department of Chemistry, Faculty of Science, University of Allahabad, Colonel Ganj, Prayagraj-211002, Uttar Pradesh.
The application should reach within 30 days from the date of advertisement.
Also send the same application as a single PDF file to [email protected].
Make sure it reaches by 25 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: M.Sc. Chemistry (General Chemistry/ Applied Chemistry/ Industrial Chemistry) with 1st class in undergraduate and post graduate degree. Desirable: Experience in Process Chemistry, Catalysts, and Electrochemistry Experience: Desirable: Experience in Process Chemistry, Catalysts, and Electrochemistry Age limit: Maximum 28 years (as on 1 April 2026) Age relaxation: SC/ST/PH As per GoI rules or the guidelines of CST-UP Other conditions: Candidate must be an Indian citizen Candidate must be a resident / domicile of Uttar Pradesh Desirable: Experience in Process Chemistry, Catalysts, and Electrochemistry

content_sections.text: Candidates who are not residents of Uttar Pradesh Candidates who are not Indian citizens

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely temporary (contractual) and co-terminus with the project; terminates automatically when the project ends Tenure three years: initially one year, renewable annually based on performance and CST UP norms Appointment may be terminated earlier depending on performance No claim to permanent appointment or absorption in the funding agency or the University Governed by CST-UP terms and conditions and service conditions of the University of Allahabad

content_sections.heading: How Will University of Allahabad Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting based on merit and need of the project Interview (in person, with original certificates) Candidates shortlisted based on merit and need of the project Only shortlisted candidates contacted via email No TA/DA for appearing in the interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application in the attached format with complete biodata Self-attested photocopies of mark sheets and certificates Supporting documents, including experience Recent passport size photograph (not older than six months) Proof of GATE/NET/JRF qualification, if any Matriculation/SSC certificate as the only accepted proof of date of birth

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Selected candidate must join duty immediately on receipt of the offer Mere possession of the qualification does not ensure a call for interview

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for University of Allahabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 25 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in University of Allahabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Junior Research Assistant (JRA).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for University of Allahabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application format attached to the advertisement (pages 3-4 of this PDF)) and send it to Dr. Varun Rai, PI, Department of Chemistry, Faculty of Science, University of Allahabad, Colonel Ganj, Prayagraj-211002, Uttar Pradesh, by registered or speed post, and the same as a single pdf file by email, to reach by 25 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 28 years (as on 1 April 2026). Relaxation: SC/ST/PH As per GoI rules or the guidelines of CST-UP.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Consolidated stipend of Rs. 25,000 per month for the first two years and Rs. 28,000 per month for the third year.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: M.Sc. Chemistry (General Chemistry/ Applied Chemistry/ Industrial Chemistry) with 1st class in undergraduate and post graduate examination. Preference for experience in Process Chemistry, Catalysts and Electrochemistry.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidate must be an Indian citizen. Candidate must be a resident / domicile of Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who are not residents of Uttar Pradesh. Candidates who are not Indian citizens.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting based on merit and need of the project. Interview (in person, with original certificates). Candidates shortlisted based on merit and need of the project. Only shortlisted candidates contacted via email.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely temporary (contractual) and co-terminus with the project; terminates automatically when the project ends. Tenure three years: initially one year, renewable annually based on performance and CST UP norms. Appointment may be terminated earlier depending on performance.
